name: Song Sparrow
facts: Call pattern: opens with two to four clear, evenly spaced notes, then tumbles into a buzzy trill. Each male rotates through several distinct versions.
Habitat: brushy edges, marsh borders, hedgerows and backyard shrubs. One of the most widespread sparrows in North America.
Migration: northern birds head south for winter, but many around the Great Lakes stay put all year.
